walkthrough.short: Look across the set and keep looking: circle round {pairs}, beside you, without turning your body.
walkthrough.long: Look straight across the set at the dancer opposite you, and keep looking at them for the whole figure — that is the mad robin. Now circle round {pairs}, who is standing beside you, the way a do-si-do goes: forward and past them on one side, sideways along the line, back behind them on the other. Your body never turns. It is a sideways do-si-do, danced looking across the set. Nobody takes hands. {where}

walkthrough.short: Circle all the way round {pairs} without turning your body, still looking across the set, and come back to your own place.
